runtimeHumanDecisionRequest.whatHappened: A sensitive Contract amendment was recorded and still requires explicit human review.
runtimeHumanDecisionRequest.whyItMatters: The amendment reason documents rationale but does not authorize a change to scope, authority, verification, or another sensitive plan decision.

options.label: Confirm the amended plan
options.effect: Record an identity-bound decision for this exact Contract and preflight snapshot.

options.label: Revise the amended plan
options.effect: Record a further reasoned amendment and rerun preflight.

options.label: Stop the Work Item
options.effect: Leave the item recoverable without starting verification.

runtimeHumanDecisionRequest.recommendationReason: Only an identity-bound human decision can satisfy the review required by a sensitive plan change.
runtimeHumanDecisionRequest.question: Do you confirm the current amended Contract for continued work?
runtimeHumanDecisionRequest.resumeCondition: A fresh preflight decision receipt matches the current Contract and repository snapshot.

approvalScope: The current exact amended WI-1085 Contract and preflight snapshot, including local requirement+registration, full-source validation, explicit_attestation, constrained root/extension resume, durable exact transition template/version, committed-original-before-next-sequence retry, one locked authoritative writer, and declared local total-loss boundary.
Continue only under current Runtime admission and after Raydot returns the independent technical review conclusion for core implementation.
excludedScope: Rewriting or silently migrating old v1 receipts, historical producer identity/time, archive/Contract/close/verification/provider bytes, or representing historical verification as current execution.
Remote trusted monotonic registry, new external trust service, bulk migration, and claims that total loss or rollback of all local provenance is detectable.
Actual source registration or historical repair of real WI-1004 records; this implementation uses isolated fixtures until a separate exact target authority exists.
WI-1084 reopening, PR1040 body changes, WI-1078 retained resources/evidence, other worktrees or dirty files, local Sentinel, Task9, and global Agent/MCP/security/permission configuration.
Release publication, tags, new PR creation without direction, Ready/merge, human close, branch/worktree deletion or resource cleanup.
General finalization, evidence cache or coordination refactoring; unrelated CI/release workflows, assertions or gate weakening.
resumeCondition: A genuine identity-bound human confirm_review receipt matches this exact Contract, preflightDecisionDigest and repositorySnapshotDigest; any changed binding requires a refreshed explicit request. No approval is inferred from Raydot ordinary technical review or older WI approvals.
